_about: Streetcars and buses (engine/fetch_surface.py, engine/surface.py). 'gtfs' says where the agency's schedule comes from: a CKAN package (ckan) or a direct zip (url). 'skip' lists route numbers already drawn by another layer (Subway & LRT). 'feeds' adds other agencies, each fetched into raw/surface/<feed>/: GO buses keep their own mode ('go') and a 'GO ' prefix so GO 41 never collides with TTC 41; they get no families (frequent, express...), which describe the TTC network. 'rapid' keeps the subway and LRT lines apart, in raw/surface/rapid_*.json, for the Routes page only. 'fallback' (in 'gtfs') lists other copies of the schedule to try when the City's file is broken; the last is the Mobility Database's archived copy from October 27, 2026, the last good one before the City's file went empty (service to December 21): drop it once the City's file is fixed.
